verdict.rationale: The public EC&VC page offers free founder resources: an online investor-readiness check that returns a personalised report and score, plus downloadable UK and DE cap table templates. These touch financing and equity, but the pack shows no plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, or equity. The only guides evidenced are UPC patent material, which is off-topic. Missing for 10: plain-language startup guides/explainers, FAQs on formation and financing, equity explainers, independent corroboration of a maintained knowledge base.
